description: Looks up one card from the Pipeworx original tarot deck by its id (e.g. "major_00", "wands_01") or its exact name (e.g. "The Fool"). Returns both upright and reversed meanings as reference, plus keywords and the image description.

name_short.description: Card id ("major_00".."major_21", "wands_01".."pentacles_14") or exact card name (e.g. "The Fool", "Ace of Wands").

name: get_card
